title: Reward prediction error: उम्मीद और नतीजे का फर्क
topic: Reward prediction error in reinforcement-learning models
claim_type: Computational reinforcement-learning model with controlled animal neurophysiology and human fMRI evidence; not a direct subjective-experience measurement.

safe: A reward prediction error models the difference between an expected and received reward in a learning task.
Better-than-expected, expected and worse-than-expected outcomes are modelled as positive, near-zero and negative prediction errors.
Controlled experiments and human neuroimaging studies provide evidence consistent with particular reward-learning models.
excluded: A reward-prediction-error term directly measures happiness, motivation, free will or an individual's mental state.
A single reinforcement-learning algorithm is established as the exact model implemented by every human brain.
